New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So nothing unusual is building up that would swing App Total Revenue in about 7 days.

insights.title: Revenue vs new subs — App Total Revenue +9.9% does not match new subs -8.7% from 7 days earlier — this growth is not coming from new customers.
insights.body: App Total Revenue on 09-01 vs 08-25 is +9.9%, but App Total New Subs on 08-25 vs 08-18 was -8.7% — they moved in opposite directions. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. Since those subs went the other way, this growth is coming from existing customers instead: check renewals and cancellations, refunds, or a recent price change — not marketing or installs.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YCV is turning installs into New Subs worse than usual (-10.2% vs Install -4.2%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YCV New Subs -10.2% vs Install -4.2% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which app — App Total Revenue +7.6% is mostly YCV — not every app.
insights.body: App Total Revenue moved +7.6% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App +7.6%, YMK +1.0%, YCP +8.1%, YCV +24.8%). YCV accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.

insights.title: Which country — JP is out of line with every other country on App Total Revenue (+44.9% vs +7.6%).
insights.body: For All App, App Total Revenue in JP is +44.9% while all countries together are +7.6% — a gap of +37.3pp. JP is about 8% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — GB turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (25.0% vs 12.4% overall).
insights.body: In GB, 25.0% of installs turn into new subs, versus 12.4% across all markets and apps (+12.7pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. GB is about 6% of revenue.

insights.title: Market trend — JP is gaining ground fast on turning installs into subs (+13.4%, now 11.5%).
insights.body: In JP, 11.5% of installs now turn into new subs — +13.4% versus last period. It is about 8% of revenue (a market worth watching): more of the people downloading are subscribing, which should help revenue within a week or two.

insights.title: Install mix — Where installs come from is shifting toward Organic Install (+8.0% vs +0.0% for installs overall).
insights.body: Organic Install was 14,644, +8.0% against the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks, while total installs moved +0.0% — a difference of +8.0 percentage points. Organic Install is now 50.4% of all installs, so the balance between channels is moving toward it.
